fields.name: Group_status_bit<x>
fields.description: Group status bit. If 亲和路由 is enabled 用于 中断安全状态中，对应中断的 bit 与 GICD_IGRPMODR<n> to form a 2-bit 字段 that defines an interrupt group. 此字段编码在 GICD_IGRPMODR<n>. 若亲和路由禁用 用于 Security state of an interrupt, then: [0b0=当 GICD_CTLR.DS==1, the corresponding interrupt is Group ; 0b1=当 GICD_CTLR.DS==1, the corresponding interrupt is Group ]
